Hi all — looping in a few operational details from the SE side.

For the load/routing smoke test we typically need:
- a quiet 60–90 minute window for the end-to-end run (including sanity checks)
- one dedicated laptop connected to Nebula VPN (we'll bring a test VM image if helpful)
- ability to open port 443 outbound to our staging endpoints; no special inbound rules required

Suggested agenda (half-day onsite):
09:30–10:00 Arrival, intros, access/badge check
10:00–11:00 Prompt review & routing rules (walk through sample prompts)
11:00–12:15 Load smoke test + monitoring walkthrough
12:15–13:00 Wrap, next steps & rollout plan

Recording: happy to record screen share. AVSupport (copied) — can you confirm if recording on the venue side requires any additional release forms?

I'll attach a short checklist of prompts and a basic load script; Vivek / Marissa can share in advance.

—Laura

Hi all — AV Support here. Quick notes for the Manhattan HQ room:
- We can provide HDMI + AirPlay for local laptops; we recommend bringing a USB-C adapter as a backup.
- Recording is permitted with venue consent form signed by both host and external vendor; we can email the form to the facility contact.
- For hybrid participants we provide Teams link + 1080p stream; if you want to capture presenter audio for transcription, we need a wired lavalier mic (we can supply).
- Onsite upload bandwidth is limited during lunch window; schedule heavy upload tasks outside 12:00–13:00 ET.

Happy to run a 15-minute AV tech check the day before (Mon Apr 20) at 16:00 ET. Reply with the contact who will be on-site for us to coordinate badge/access.
